report.summary: Food-resource options for patient P-D008 (age 41, Medicaid, English-speaking, home census tract 17031400800). Identified four food resources near the patient's tract. Eligibility: W01 (community fridge) is open daily with no eligibility barrier ("take what you need"); W04 (Northwest Side Food Pantry) requires no ID, open Mon/Wed/Fri 12–3 PM with fresh produce Wednesdays; W02 (Saturday Market Pantry) is for Cook County residents, Saturdays 9 AM–noon (patient's tract is in Cook County, IL, so likely eligible); W03 (Harvest Table Pantry) advertises an instant eligibility check via a partner endpoint, but I could not execute that external check from this environment—eligibility should be verified directly with the pantry. No phone numbers were listed for these resources.
